raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

GLM-5.3-Flash decode TPOT **-12% at concurrency 1 on 2x DGX Spark (SM121, TP=2)**. On `nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4` the attention projections (KDA and MLA), shared experts and LM head stay BF16 and take roughly 46 of a 68 ms decode step on cuBLAS gemv. `glm5next` has no low-latency GEMM module yet, so this adds one modelled on `qwen4_exp/nvidia/low_latency_gemm.py` (#59753, #59632, #61437) with measured SM121 plans for the TP=2 local shapes, installed from `Glm5NextForCausalLM` and `Glm5NextMTP`.

## Claims

- 7 local `(N, K)` shapes at M = 1/2/4 (20 entries), routed only on capability `(12, 1)`; other GPUs, dtypes, token counts and shapes keep the standard linear path.
- Kernel: 1.35x to 1.74x over cuBLAS gemv at M=1 (238-283 GB/s vs 162-176 GB/s), 1.04x to 1.36x at M=2/4.
- End to end, no speculation, concurrency 1: TPOT 64.9 -> 57.0 ms (-12%), 15.0 -> 17.0 tok/s. With MTP k=3 the target forward runs at M=4, where cuBLAS already uses a GEMM kernel: ITL -2.5%, TPOT and tok/s unchanged.
- GSM8K (n=100): 93 base, 94 plans.

## Validation

Probe through the module path on GB10 (CUDA graph replay, weight rotated out of L2, nightly 8e2beaa3bf), cosine 1.000000 vs `F.linear` for every entry:

| local (N, K) | layer | calls/step | M=1 cuBLAS us | M=1 plan us | M=1 | M=2 | M=4 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| (12576, 4096) | KDA in_proj | 34 | 608 | 429 | 1.42x | 1.07x | 1.05x |
| (4096, 4096) | KDA o_proj | 34 | 204 | 137 | 1.48x | 1.08x | 1.06x |
| (2048, 4096) | shared gate_up, MLA qkv_a | 53 | 103 | 64 | 1.61x | 1.22x | 1.24x |
| (4096, 1024) | shared down | 42 | 51 | 30 | 1.74x | 1.34x | 1.36x |
| (8192, 1536) | MLA q_b | 11 | 147 | 102 | 1.45x | 1.13x | 1.20x |
| (4096, 8192) | MLA o_proj | 11 | 291 | cuBLAS | 1.01x (not listed) | 1.04x | 1.07x |
| (77440, 4096) | lm_head | 1 | 3606 | 2663 | 1.35x | 1.05x | 1.06x |

These are cold-L2 numbers, which is the serving case: decode reads each weight once per step and 45 layers do not fit the 24 MB L2. The M=1 entries add up to 12.8 ms per step; the server gains 8 ms because the GEMMs interleave with MoE and attention. M=8/16 are within 2% of cuBLAS and are not listed.

End to end, `nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4` TP=2 on two Sparks, FP8 KV, SPEED-Bench 2K in / 1K out, 4 requests at concurrency 1, two interleaved runs per arm, nightly 8e2beaa3bf:

| Arm | TPOT p50 (ms) | ITL p50 (ms) | Output tok/s | GSM8K (n=100) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| base | 64.83 / 64.98 | 64.53 / 64.64 | 15.06 / 14.87 | 93 |
| plans | 57.85 / 56.16 (**-12%**) | 58.88 / 55.20 | 16.77 / 17.30 | 94 |

With MTP k=3 (`--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`, 2026-10-17 nightly):

| Arm | ITL p50 (ms) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Output tok/s | Acceptance length |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| base | 102.18 / 102.73 | 40.93 / 41.52 | 24.21 / 23.48 | 2.60 / 2.52 |
| plans | 99.56 / 100.27 (-2.5%) | 41.76 / 42.01 | 23.85 / 23.71 | 2.48 / 2.48 |

An nsys census of the plans arm shows every listed shape on `CuteSkinnyGemm` in the server (45% of GPU time without speculation, 39.5% with MTP); what is left on cuBLAS is KDA `f_b`/`g_b` (4096, 128) (#57617), the fp32-output router gate (288, 4096) and MLA o_proj at M=1.

Tests: `pytest tests/kernels/test_bf16_skinny_gemm.py -k glm5next`, 26 passed on GB10 (table validity, capability routing, hook installation, 20 selected shapes with cosine > 0.999). The selected-shape test skips off capability (12, 1), which CI does not have.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction</summary>

```bash
# on each DGX Spark, --node-rank 0 / 1
vllm serve nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --nnodes 2 --node-rank 0 \
  --master-addr 192.168.100.1 --master-port 29500 --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.84 --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --enable-prefix-caching --disable-custom-all-reduce \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune --reasoning-parser glm45 --kv-cache-dtype fp8
vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
  --dataset-name speed_bench --speed-bench-dataset-subset throughput_2k \
  --speed-bench-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --num-warmups 2 --num-prompts 4 --max-concurrency 1 --seed 0
pytest tests/kernels/test_bf16_skinny_gemm.py -k glm5next
```

</details>

## Details

- Plans come from a CUDA-graph sweep over block_size, outputs_per_block, k_unroll, vector_width and static_k with the weight rotated out of L2, keeping entries that beat cuBLAS by more than 5%. `(2048, 4096)` serves both the shared-expert gate/up and the MLA fused q_a/kv_a projection.
- The replacement method follows the quant method the layer carries: a quant config that excludes `lm_head` gives `ParallelLMHead` an `UnquantizedLinearMethod` rather than an `UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod`, and the head stayed on cuBLAS until this was handled.
- Not covered: TP=1 (the model does not fit one Spark), KDA `f_b`/`g_b` `(4096, 128)` (#57617), MTP `eh_proj` (a plain `nn.Linear`), and M=3, which uses cuBLAS.
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for the sweep scripts, the module and the tests; all code and measurements were reviewed and run by the author.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(glm5next_gemm, "LinearBase", FakeLinear)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(glm5next_gemm, "ParallelLMHead", FakeHead)

+    monkeypatch.setattr(

+    assert type(root.unlisted.quant_method) is glm5next_gemm.UnquantizedLinearMethod
+    assert isinstance(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""GLM-5.3-Flash decode GEMM selection on NVIDIA GPUs.
+
+Dispatch follows Qwen4Exp and uses the local ``(N, K)`` shape and token count.
+Plans contain measured CUDA graph capture sizes; other token counts use the
+standard linear implementation.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.skinny_gemm import (
+    SkinnyGemmConfig,
+    row_stride_ok,
+    shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase, UnquantizedLinearMethod
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import direct_register_custom_op
+
+# DGX Spark (GB10) plans for TP=2 local shapes.
+GLM5NEXT_SM121_GEMM_PLANS: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[int, SkinnyGemmConfig]] = {
+    # Shared-expert fused gate/up and MLA fused q_a/kv_a projections, TP=2.
+    (2048, 4096): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 32, 1, k_unroll=4, static_k=4096),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 64, 1, k_unroll=4, vector_width=4, static_k=4096),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 128, 1, vector_width=2, static_k=4096),
+    },
+    # Shared-expert down projection, TP=2.
+    (4096, 1024): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 64, 1, vector_width=2, static_k=1024),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 64, 1, vector_width=2, static_k=1024),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 64, 1, vector_width=2, static_k=1024),
+    },
+    # KDA output projection, TP=2.
+    (4096, 4096): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 32, 2, k_unroll=4, vector_width=4, static_k=4096),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 64, 1, k_unroll=4, vector_width=2, static_k=4096),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 64, 1, vector_width=2, static_k=4096),
+    },
+    # MLA output projection, TP=2.
+    (4096, 8192): {
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 64, 2, k_unroll=2, vector_width=2, static_k=8192),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 256, 1, k_unroll=2, static_k=8192),
+    },
+    # MLA q_b projection, TP=2.
+    (8192, 1536): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 32, 1, k_unroll=4, vector_width=2, static_k=1536),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 32, 1, k_unroll=2, vector_width=2, static_k=1536),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 32, 1, k_unroll=2, vector_width=2, static_k=1536),
+    },
+    # KDA fused QKV/beta/f_a/g_a input projection, TP=2.
+    (12576, 4096): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 256, 1, k_unroll=2, vector_width=2),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 256, 1),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 128, 1, k_unroll=4, vector_width=4, static_k=4096),
+    },
+    # LM head, TP=2.
+    (77440, 4096): {
+        1: SkinnyGemmConfig(1, 256, 1, static_k=4096),
+        2: SkinnyGemmConfig(2, 256, 1, k_unroll=2),
+        4: SkinnyGemmConfig(4, 256, 1, k_unroll=2),
+    },
+}
+
+
+GLM5NEXT_GEMM_PLANS_BY_CAPABILITY: dict[
+    tuple[int, int] | None, dict[tuple[int, int], dict[int, SkinnyGemmConfig]]
+] = {
+    (12, 1): GLM5NEXT_SM121_GEMM_PLANS,
+}
+
+
+def _is_packed_row_major(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return tensor.dim() == 2 and tensor.stride() == (tensor.shape[1], 1)
+
+
+def _runtime_ok(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, config: SkinnyGemmConfig
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        not envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and row_stride_ok(x, config)
+        and _is_packed_row_major(weight)
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and x.is_cuda
+        and weight.is_cuda
+        and x.device == weight.device
+        and x.shape[1] == weight.shape[1]
+    )
+
+
+class _Glm5NextLowLatencyApply:
+    def apply(
+        self,
+        layer: nn.Module,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if bias is None and not envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT:
+            return torch.ops.vllm.glm5next_low_latency_gemm(x, layer.weight)
+        return super().apply(layer, x, bias)  # type: ignore[misc]
+
+
+class Glm5NextLowLatencyLinearMethod(_Glm5NextLowLatencyApply, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
+    pass
+
+
+class Glm5NextLowLatencyEmbeddingMethod(
+    _Glm5NextLowLatencyApply, UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod
+):
+    pass
+
+
+# A quant config that excludes ``lm_head`` (the modelopt NVFP4 checkpoints do)
+# hands ParallelLMHead an UnquantizedLinearMethod rather than an
+# UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod, so the replacement is chosen by the method the
+# layer actually carries.
+_LOW_LATENCY_METHODS: dict[type, type] = {
+    UnquantizedLinearMethod: Glm5NextLowLatencyLinearMethod,
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod: Glm5NextLowLatencyEmbeddingMethod,
+}
+
+
+def _glm5next_low_latency_gemm(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    plans = GLM5NEXT_GEMM_PLANS_BY_CAPABILITY.get(
+        current_platform.get_device_capability(), {}
+    )
+    plan = plans.get((weight.shape[0], weight.shape[1]))
+    config = None if plan is None else plan.get(x.shape[0])
+    if (
+        config is not None
+        and _runtime_ok(x, weight, config)
+        and shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm.is_available()
+    ):
+        return shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(x, weight, config)
+    return torch.nn.functional.linear(x, weight)
+
+
+def _glm5next_low_latency_gemm_fake(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return x.new_empty((*x.shape[:-1], weight.shape[0]))
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="glm5next_low_latency_gemm",
+    op_func=_glm5next_low_latency_gemm,
+    fake_impl=_glm5next_low_latency_gemm_fake,
+)
+
+
+def enable_glm5next_low_latency_gemm(
+    module: nn.Module,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> None:
+    plans = GLM5NEXT_GEMM_PLANS_BY_CAPABILITY.get(
+        current_platform.get_device_capability(), {}
+    )
+    if dtype != torch.bfloat16 or not plans:
+        return
+    if not shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm.is_available():
+        return
+
+    warmup_configs: set[SkinnyGemmConfig] = set()
+    for child in module.modules():
+        if not isinstance(child, (LinearBase, ParallelLMHead)):
+            continue
+        method_cls = _LOW_LATENCY_METHODS.get(type(child.quant_method))
+        if method_cls is None:
+            continue
+        weight = getattr(child, "weight", None)
+        if weight is None or weight.dim() != 2:
+            continue
+        plan = plans.get((weight.shape[0], weight.shape[1]))
+        if plan is None:
+            continue
+        child.quant_method = method_cls()
+        warmup_configs.update(plan.values())
+
+    if warmup_configs:
+        shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm.request_warmup_configs(dtype, warmup_configs)
